blockers.wanted: output lufs -20 to land near -20 LUFS
blockers.tried: lufs -16/-20/-26/-34 on a 0.4 s peaky sound; each came out 6-10 dB short with the peak 8-10 dB under the -1 ceiling, and the warning blamed the ceiling limiter
blockers.workaround: found the cause myself: my mix peaked +9.9 dBFS so the lookahead limiter flattened everything. Dropped lufs, set gain_db by hand, exported at -28.6 LUFS

blockers.wanted: an impulse click at t=0 to be the loudest sample
blockers.tried: impulse at 0 into resonators; the default 2 ms fade-in cut it by about 7 dB and the body became the peak
blockers.workaround: moved the click to 3 ms and the body to 12 ms

blockers.wanted: attack time to the peak for the brief's attack under 5 ms
blockers.tried: attack reads 0.000 s while peak_t is 0.010 s (body peaks after the click); the meaning is not documented
blockers.workaround: read peak_t, the waveform and the first-fifth bands instead

blockers.wanted: one type's schema; a duration check with min/max
blockers.tried: describe_op with type and op returned the full list silently (the argument is kind); verify with expect or checks showed no duration line and no error
blockers.workaround: kind worked; duration read from listen (0.5 s with a set duration)

blockers.where: latch / mechanism click, and a thump source
blockers.wanted: a one-node latch or contact click and a low body hit
blockers.tried: impulse into high resonators for the click, 4 low resonators plus lowpassed brown noise for the body
blockers.workaround: hand-built modes; the body's modes beat against each other in the waveform (lumpy)
